newsitem.title: PHILIPPINES: Phil Racing Club 1996 net seen doubling.
newsitem.headline: Phil Racing Club 1996 net seen doubling.

text.p: Philippine Racing Club Inc is expected to post a net income about 10.1 to 10.2 million pesos in 1996, almost double from 5.146 million pesos in the previous year, a company official said on Tuesday.
Vice president for finance Teng Goh told Reuters the higher income would come from larger bets received from the public.
"The amount being wagered by the public has increased a lot," Goh said.
Wagers received from racing aficionados rose by 22 percent to about 1.3 billion pesos from the previous year's 1.068 billion pesos.
The racetrack operator is expected to submit its unaudited financial statement to the Securities and Exchange Commission this week. - Manila newsroom 63 2 8418938 Fax 8176267
